questions.text: निम्नलिखित में से कौन सा कार्य 'उच्च-स्तरीय प्रबन्ध' द्वारा कार्यान्वित नहीं किया जाता, पहचानिए :
questions.text_english: Identify which of the following functions is Not performed by 'Top Level Management' :

options.A: संगठन के सुचारु संचालन के लिए अन्य विभागों के साथ सामंजस्य स्थापित करना ।
options.B: संगठन के कल्याण एवं निरंतरता के लिए उत्तरदायी ।
options.C: व्यावसायिक पर्यावरण का विश्लेषण एवं फर्म की जीवितता पर इसका प्रभाव ।
options.D: समग्र संगठनात्मक लक्ष्यों का निर्माण एवं उनकी प्राप्ति के लिए व्यूह-रचना करना ।

options_english.A: Cooperating with other departments for smooth functioning of the organisation.
options_english.B: Being responsible for the welfare and survival of the organization.
options_english.C: Analyzing the business environment and its implications for the survival of the firm.
options_english.D: Formulating overall organizational goals and strategies for their achievement.

questions.solution: Option (A) is correct. Cooperating with other departments for smooth functioning is a function of Middle Level Management, not Top Level Management. Top Level Management is responsible for setting overall organizational goals (D), analyzing the business environment (C), and ensuring welfare and survival of the organization (B). Middle-level managers act as a bridge between top management and operational staff, and are specifically responsible for inter-departmental coordination.

questions.text: नीचे के चित्र में दिया गया प्रश्न-चिह्न एक वित्तीय प्रोत्साहन का प्रतिनिधित्व करता है । प्रोत्साहन को पहचानिए :
questions.text_english:
The question mark in the picture given below represents a financial incentive. Identify the incentive : 
 For Visually Impaired Candidates : 
Authority, responsibility, rewards, perquisites and prestige of job etc. indicate which of the following non-financial incentives given to a person holding a managerial position ?
questions.solution:
Option (D) Perquisites (अनुलाभ/परक्विजिट) is correct. The diagram shows benefits like company-provided housing, education for children, car allowance, and medical aid — all of which are non-cash benefits provided to employees over and above their salary. These are collectively called Perquisites or 'Perks'. Pay and allowances (A) are direct cash payments, retirement benefits (B) are post-service benefits, and productivity-linked incentives (C) are tied to output levels. The image clearly shows non-cash fringe benefits that define perquisites.

Note for Visually Impaired Candidates: Authority, responsibility, rewards, perquisites and prestige of job indicate 'Status' as a non-financial incentive. Correct answer for that alternate question is (C) Status.

questions.text: वह प्रक्रिया जिसके माध्यम से एक प्रबंधक विभिन्न विभागों की गतिविधियों में एकात्मकता लाता है, जानी जाती है :
questions.text_english: The process by which a manager synchronizes the activities of different departments is known as :
questions.solution: Option (D) Co-ordination is correct. Co-ordination is the process by which a manager synchronizes and integrates the activities of different departments to achieve common organizational goals. Management (A) is a broader concept encompassing all functions. Planning (B) involves setting goals and deciding courses of action. Organising (C) involves establishing a structure of roles. Only Co-ordination specifically refers to harmonizing the activities of various departments.

questions.text: कॉलम I में दिए गए गैर-वित्तीय प्रोत्साहनों का कॉलम II में दिए गए उनके अर्थ के साथ मिलान कीजिए :
questions.text_english:
Match the non-financial incentives given in Column I with their meaning given in Column II : 
Choose the correct option from the options given below :
questions.instruction_line: नीचे दिए गए विकल्पों में से सही विकल्प का चयन कीजिए :
questions.instruction_line_english: Choose the correct option from the options given below :
questions.solution: Option (C) is correct: a-iv, b-i, c-iii, d-ii. Employee Participation (a) means involving employees in decision making related to issues affecting them (iv). Organisational Climate (b) indicates the characteristics that describe and distinguish one organisation from another (i). Employee Empowerment (c) means giving more autonomy and powers to subordinates (iii). Status (d) means the ranking of positions in the organisation (ii). This matching correctly captures the standard definitions of these non-financial incentives as per the CBSE syllabus.

questions.text: किसी व्यवसाय की कोष आवश्यकताओं का अनुमान लगाना एवं कोष के स्रोतों को निर्दिष्ट करने की प्रक्रिया, कहलाती है _______ ।
questions.text_english: The process of estimating the fund requirements of a business and specifying the sources of funds is called _______.
questions.solution: Option (D) Financial Planning is correct. Financial Planning is the process of estimating the fund requirements of a business and specifying the sources from which these funds can be obtained. Trading on Equity (A) is a technique to increase returns to equity shareholders. Capital Budgeting (B) refers to decisions related to long-term investment in fixed assets. Financial Management (C) is a broader concept that covers all aspects of financial decision-making, not just estimation and sourcing of funds.

questions.text: 'चूँकि व्यावसायिक पर्यावरण में विभिन्न स्रोतों से उत्पन्न होने वाली अनेक परस्पर सम्बन्धित एवं गतिशील स्थितियाँ एवं शक्तियाँ सम्मिलित होती हैं, अत: तुरंत यह समझना कठिन हो जाता है कि वर्तमान पर्यावरण यथार्थ रूप से किन तत्त्वों से बना है ।'
questions.text_english: 'Since business environment consists of numerous interrelated and dynamic conditions or forces which arise from different sources, it becomes difficult to comprehend at once what exactly constitutes a given environment.'
questions.instruction_line: उपरोक्त में प्रकाशित व्यावसायिक पर्यावरण की विशेषता है :
questions.instruction_line_english: The feature of business environment highlighted above is :
questions.solution: Option (C) Complexity is correct. The statement describes how business environment is made up of numerous interrelated and dynamic forces from different sources, making it difficult to comprehend at once — this precisely defines Complexity. Relativity (A) means environment differs from firm to firm. Uncertainty (B) refers to difficulty in predicting changes. Dynamic Nature (D) refers to the ever-changing character of the environment. The key phrase 'difficult to comprehend at once what exactly constitutes' clearly points to Complexity.

questions.text:
कथन-I : कार्य शक्ति विश्लेषण विभिन्न कार्यों के निष्पादन तथा संगठनिक उद्देश्यों की पूर्ति के लिए कितनी संख्या में तथा किस प्रकार के मानव संसाधनों की आवश्यकता होगी, के निर्धारण को संभव बनाता है ।
कथन-II : कार्य भार विश्लेषण से पता चलता है कि कितनी संख्या में तथा किस प्रकार के मानव संसाधन उपलब्ध हैं ।
questions.text_english:
Statement-I : Workforce analysis enables an assessment of the number and types of human resources necessary for the performance of various jobs and accomplishment of organizational objectives.
Statement-II : Workload analysis reveals the number and type of human resources available.
questions.instruction_line: निम्नलिखित में से सही विकल्प का चयन कीजिए :
questions.instruction_line_english: Choose the correct option from the following :

options.A: कथन-I सत्य है तथा कथन-II असत्य है ।
options.B: कथन-I असत्य है तथा कथन-II सत्य है ।
options.C: दोनों कथन-I तथा कथन-II सत्य हैं ।
options.D: दोनों कथन-I तथा कथन-II असत्य हैं ।

options_english.A: Statement-I is true and Statement-II is false.
options_english.B: Statement-I is false and Statement-II is true.
options_english.C: Both Statement-I and Statement-II are true.
options_english.D: Both Statement-I and Statement-II are false.

questions.solution: Option (A) is correct — Statement-I is true and Statement-II is false. Workforce analysis correctly determines the number and type of human resources required for performing various jobs and achieving organizational goals, making Statement-I true. However, Statement-II is false because Workload analysis determines the number and type of human resources needed (demand side), not the number available. It is Workforce analysis that reveals the availability of human resources. The two concepts are often confused, but their functions are distinct.

questions.text:
एन वी इलेक्ट्रॉनिक्स के पास स्मार्ट-फोन, टी.वी., होम एंटरटेनमेंट सिस्टम, रसोई उपकरणों तथा एयर कंडीशनर्स की एक नवीन शृंखला है । गुणात्मक उत्पादों की पूर्ति के अलावा उनका केन्द्र बिन्दु उपभोक्ताओं की शिकायतों का शीघ्रता से निपटान करना, रख-रखाव सेवाएँ प्रदान करना, उधार सेवाएँ प्रदान करना इत्यादि भी है ।
उपरोक्त में चर्चित विपणन का कार्य है :
questions.text_english:
NV Electronics has an innovative range of smartphones, T.V's, home entertainment systems, kitchen appliances and air conditioners. Besides supplying quality products, their focus is also on handling customer complaints speedily, providing maintenance services, procuring credit services etc.
The function of marketing discussed above is :
questions.solution: Option (D) Customer support services is correct. The passage describes NV Electronics focusing on handling customer complaints speedily, providing maintenance services, and procuring credit services — all of which are after-sales support activities that fall under Customer Support Services. Branding (A) relates to creating and managing brand identity. Marketing Planning (B) involves setting marketing objectives and strategies. Product designing and development (C) relates to creating and improving products. None of these match the after-sales service focus described in the passage.

questions.text: वैज्ञानिक प्रबंध की एक तकनीक के रूप में 'गति अध्ययन' के सम्बन्ध में कौन सा कथन गलत है, पहचानिए :
questions.text_english: Identify the incorrect statement with respect to 'Motion Study', as a technique of scientific management :

options.A: अनावश्यक चेष्टाओं को समाप्त किया जाता है ताकि कार्य को भलीभाँति पूरा करने में कम समय लगे ।
options.B: यह विभिन्न प्रकार की मुद्राओं के अध्ययन से सम्बन्धित है, जो किसी विशेष कार्य को करने के लिए की जाती हैं जैसे उठाना, वस्तुएँ रखना, बैठना या स्थान बदलना आदि ।
options.C: इस तकनीक के माध्यम से, टेलर ऐसे उपकरण एवं औज़ार डिज़ाइन करने में सफल रहा जो श्रमिकों को उनके उपयोग के सम्बन्ध में शिक्षित करने में उपयुक्त थे ।
options.D: यह तकनीक नियुक्त किए जाने वाले कर्मियों की संख्या का निर्धारण करने, उपयुक्त प्रेरक योजनाओं को तैयार करने तथा श्रम लागत का निर्धारण करने में सहायता करती है ।

options_english.A: Unnecessary movements are sought to be eliminated so that it takes less time to complete the job efficiently.
options_english.B: It refers to the study of movements like lifting, putting objects, sitting and changing positions etc., which are undertaken while doing a typical job.
options_english.C: Through this technique, Taylor was able to design suitable equipment and tools to educate workers on their use.
options_english.D: This technique helps to determine the number of workers to be employed, frame suitable incentive schemes and determine labour costs.

questions.solution: Option (D) is the incorrect statement. Determining the number of workers to be employed, framing incentive schemes, and determining labour costs are functions of Time Study, not Motion Study. Motion Study is specifically concerned with studying and eliminating unnecessary physical movements (A) while performing a task — like lifting, placing objects, sitting, and changing positions (B). Through motion study, Taylor also designed tools and equipment suitable for workers (C). Option (D) incorrectly attributes functions of Time Study to Motion Study.
questions.topic: Techniques of Scientific Management - Motion Study

questions.text: 'प्राथमिक बाज़ार' में प्रतिभूतियों के मूल्य का निर्धारण होता है :
questions.text_english: In the 'Primary Market' prices of securities are determined by :

options.B: प्रतिभूति की माँग एवं आपूर्ति द्वारा

options_english.B: Demand and supply of the security

questions.solution: Option (A) Management of the company is correct. In the Primary Market, securities are issued for the first time and prices are determined by the management of the company issuing the securities, often in consultation with underwriters and merchant bankers. This is unlike the Secondary Market (Stock Exchange) where prices are determined by the demand and supply forces (B). Employees (C) have no role in price determination. Only demand (D) alone does not set prices in any market. The primary market involves fresh issues where the company fixes the price.

questions.text:
रमेश एक रूम हीटर खरीदना चाहता था क्योंकि सर्दी बहुत अधिक हो गई थी । एक अच्छे रूम हीटर की खोज में वह पास के बाज़ार में गया । सबसे पहले उसने कुछ बड़ी दुकानों का दौरा किया जो ब्रान्डेड हीटर बेच रही थीं और उनके डिज़ाइन, गुणवत्ता तथा मूल्य की जाँच की । बाज़ार में चलते-चलते उसने सड़क किनारे की एक दुकान देखी जो एक आकर्षक रूम हीटर प्रदर्शित कर रही थी । वह दुकान के अंदर गया ताकि रूम हीटर के बारे में जानकारी प्राप्त कर सके । दुकानदार ने दिखाया कि हीटर किस प्रकार काम करता है और साथ-साथ उसके गुण जैसे उसका घूमने वाला कार्य, ऑटोकट इत्यादि भी समझाए ।
रमेश ने उसका मूल्य पूछा और निर्णय लिया कि वह इसे खरीदेगा, क्योंकि अन्य रूम हीटरों की तुलना में यह सस्ता था और इसमें कुछ अतिरिक्त विशेषताएँ भी थीं । लेकिन इसके मूल्य तथा विशेषताओं पर ध्यान केन्द्रित करते समय, उसने ISI मार्क तथा उस लेबल की जाँच नहीं की जिस पर निर्माण की तिथि, सुरक्षा विशेषताएँ, उपयोग के निर्देश इत्यादि प्रदर्शित होते हैं ।
उपरोक्त स्थिति में रमेश द्वारा जिस अधिकार का प्रयोग किया गया, वह है :
questions.text_english:
Ramesh wanted to buy a room heater as it had become extremely cold. He went to the nearby market in search of a good room heater. He first visited a few big shops selling branded heaters and checked the design, quality and the price. Walking through the market he saw a road side shop displaying an attractive room heater. He walked into the shop to enquire about the room heater. The shopkeeper demonstrated how the heater worked and simultaneously explained its qualities like its rotating function, auto-cut etc.
Ramesh asked about its price and decided to buy it, as in comparison to other room heaters, it was cheaper and had various additional features. However while focusing on the price and features, he did not check the ISI mark or the label which displayed the date of manufacturing, safety features, directions for use etc.
The right exercised by Ramesh in the above case is :
questions.solution: Option (A) Right to choose/be assured is correct. Ramesh visited multiple shops, compared designs, quality and prices of branded heaters before making his purchase decision. This act of comparing alternatives and making an informed choice reflects the exercise of the Right to Choose. The Right to be Heard (B) relates to filing complaints. The Right to Consumer Education (C) involves awareness about consumer rights. The Right to Safety (D) is about protection from hazardous products — Ramesh actually failed to exercise this right by not checking the ISI mark.

questions.text:
कथन-I : पूँजी बाज़ार के प्रलेख प्रतिफल एवं मूलधन वापसी दोनों की दृष्टि से मुद्रा बाज़ार के प्रलेखों से सुरक्षित होते हैं ।
कथन-II : पूँजी बाज़ार मध्यम एवं दीर्घकालीन प्रतिभूतियों जैसे समता अंश और ऋणपत्रों आदि में लेन-देन करते हैं ।
questions.text_english:
Statement-I : Capital market instruments are safer than money market instruments both with respect to returns and principal repayment.
Statement-II : The capital market deals in medium and long-term securities such as equity shares and debentures etc.
questions.instruction_line: निम्नलिखित में से सही विकल्प का चयन कीजिए :
questions.instruction_line_english: Choose the correct option from the following :

options.A: कथन-I सत्य है तथा कथन-II असत्य है ।
options.B: कथन-I असत्य है तथा कथन-II सत्य है ।
options.C: दोनों कथन-I तथा कथन-II सत्य हैं ।
options.D: दोनों कथन-I तथा कथन-II असत्य हैं ।

options_english.A: Statement I is true and Statement II is false.
options_english.B: Statement I is false and Statement II is true.
options_english.C: Both Statement I and Statement II are true.
options_english.D: Both Statement I and Statement II are false.

questions.solution: Option (B) is correct — Statement I is false and Statement II is true. Statement I is false because capital market instruments are generally riskier than money market instruments. Money market instruments are short-term and have higher liquidity and safety, whereas capital market instruments carry higher risk due to their long-term nature and market fluctuations. Statement II is true because the capital market indeed deals in medium and long-term securities like equity shares and debentures, distinguishing it from the money market which handles short-term instruments.

questions.text:
यहाँ दो कथन दिए गए हैं, अभिकथन (A) तथा कारण (R) ।
अभिकथन (A) : नियंत्रण को प्रबंध के अंतिम कार्य के रूप में समझने की भूल नहीं की जानी चाहिए ।
कारण (R) : नियंत्रण वह कार्य है जो प्रबंधन चक्र को वापिस नियोजन कार्य पर लाता है ।
questions.text_english:
There are two statements, Assertion (A) and Reason (R).
Assertion (A) : Controlling should not be misunderstood as the last function of management.
Reason (R) : Controlling is a function that brings the management cycle back to the planning function.
questions.instruction_line: नीचे दिए गए विकल्पों में से सही विकल्प का चयन कीजिए :
questions.instruction_line_english: Choose the correct alternative from those given below :

options.A: अभिकथन (A) असत्य है तथा कारण (R) सत्य है ।
options.B: अभिकथन (A) तथा कारण (R) दोनों असत्य हैं ।
options.C: अभिकथन (A) सत्य है तथा कारण (R) असत्य है ।
options.D: अभिकथन (A) तथा कारण (R) दोनों सत्य हैं तथा कारण (R), अभिकथन (A) की सही व्याख्या है ।

options_english.A: Assertion (A) is false and Reason (R) is true.
options_english.B: Both Assertion (A) and Reason (R) are false.
options_english.C: Assertion (A) is true and Reason (R) is false.
options_english.D: Both Assertion (A) and Reason (R) are true and Reason (R) is the correct explanation of Assertion (A).

questions.solution: Option (D) is correct. Both the Assertion and the Reason are true, and the Reason correctly explains the Assertion. Controlling should not be misunderstood as merely the last function because it is a continuous process that feeds back into planning — this is exactly what the Reason explains. When controlling reveals deviations from the plan, it triggers a return to the planning function to revise objectives or strategies. This cyclical nature of management proves why controlling is not simply a terminal function.

questions.text:
'लिमा' एक वैश्विक स्पोर्ट्सवियर ब्रान्ड है जो अपने जूतों, परिधान एवं खेल सहायक सामग्री के लिए जानी जाती है । उपभोक्ता लिमा के जूते, टी-शर्ट्स तथा बैग इत्यादि लिमा उत्पादों पर छपे टाइगर चिह्न को देखते ही पहचान लेते हैं । लिमा ने दोनों अपने नाम 'लिमा' तथा इसके चिह्न 'टाइगर' को कानूनी रूप से पंजीकृत करा रखा है ताकि कोई अन्य कम्पनी अपने स्पोर्ट्सवियर में कानूनी रूप से बिलकुल ऐसा या इससे मिलते-जुलते डिज़ाइन का प्रयोग न कर सके ।
'लिमा' का टाइगर चिह्न है :
questions.text_english:
'Lima' is a global sportswear brand known for shoes, apparel and sports accessories. Customers can recognize Lima's shoes, t-shirts and bags just by seeing the tiger symbol imprinted on all Lima's products. Lima has legally registered both its name 'Lima' and its tiger symbol so that no other company can legally use the same or similar design in their sportswear.
The tiger symbol is Lima's :

options.D: ब्रांड मार्क तथा ट्रेड मार्क दोनों

options_english.D: Both Brand mark and Trade mark

questions.solution: Option (D) Both Brand mark and Trade mark is correct. The tiger symbol is a Brand mark because it is a visual symbol (not spoken) that identifies Lima's products. It is also a Trade mark because Lima has legally registered this symbol, giving it legal protection against use by others. A Brand mark is that part of a brand which can be recognised but cannot be spoken (like a symbol or design), while a Trade mark is a brand or part of a brand that has been given legal protection. Since the tiger symbol fulfills both criteria, option (D) is the most complete and correct answer.
questions.topic: Branding - Brand Mark and Trade Mark

questions.text:
यहाँ दो कथन दिए गए हैं, अभिकथन (A) तथा कारण (R) ।
अभिकथन (A) : विकसित कम्पनियों में लाभांश उन कम्पनियों से अधिक होता है जो विकसित नहीं हो पाई हैं ।
कारण (R) : अच्छे विकास के अवसर वाली कम्पनियाँ अपनी आय में से अधिक राशि प्रतिधारित करती हैं ताकि आवश्यक निवेश के लिए वित्तपोषण किया जा सके ।
questions.text_english:
There are two statements, Assertion (A) and Reason (R).
Assertion (A) : The dividend in growth companies is more than that in the non-growth companies.
Reason (R) : Companies having good growth opportunities retain more money out of their earnings so as to finance the required investment.
questions.instruction_line: नीचे दिए गए विकल्पों में से सही विकल्प का चयन कीजिए :
questions.instruction_line_english: Choose the correct alternative from those given below :

options.A: अभिकथन (A) असत्य है तथा कारण (R) सत्य है ।
options.B: अभिकथन (A) तथा कारण (R) दोनों असत्य हैं ।
options.C: अभिकथन (A) सत्य है तथा कारण (R) असत्य है ।
options.D: अभिकथन (A) तथा कारण (R) दोनों सत्य हैं तथा कारण (R), अभिकथन (A) की सही व्याख्या है ।

options_english.A: Assertion (A) is false and Reason (R) is true.
options_english.B: Both Assertion (A) and Reason (R) are false.
options_english.C: Assertion (A) is true and Reason (R) is false.
options_english.D: Both Assertion (A) and Reason (R) are true and Reason (R) is the correct explanation of Assertion (A).

questions.solution: Option (A) is correct — Assertion (A) is false and Reason (R) is true. The Assertion is false because growth companies actually pay lower dividends, not higher, since they retain most of their earnings to finance future investment opportunities. The Reason is true — companies with good growth prospects do retain more of their earnings, which explains why they pay less dividend. Thus, the Reason, while being true, actually contradicts the Assertion, making the Assertion false. This is a classic case where the Reason is true but the Assertion based on it is incorrectly stated.

questions.text:
अलका मोटर्स भारत की अग्रणीय ऑटो-मोबाइल कम्पनियों में से एक है । इलेक्ट्रिक वाहनों की बढ़ती हुई माँग के कारण, अलका मोटर्स ने अपने व्यवसाय के विस्तार की योजना बनाई और इसके लिए वह कोष एकत्रित करना चाहती थी । वित्तीय प्रबंधक ने सुझाव दिया कि चूँकि बाज़ार तेजी पर है अत: इसे समता के माध्यम से कोष एकत्रित करने चाहिए । वित्तीय प्रबंधक के सुझाव के अनुसार कम्पनी ने अपनी इलेक्ट्रिक वाहनों की विस्तार योजना के लिए समता द्वारा ` 3,500 करोड़ एकत्रित करने का निर्णय लिया ।
समता के माध्यम से कोष एकत्रित करने के लिए वित्त प्रबंधक द्वारा ध्यान में रखा गया घटक था :
questions.text_english:
Alka Motors is one of the leading automobile companies in India. Due to growing demand for electric vehicles, Alka Motors planned to expand its business and for this, it wanted to raise funds. The finance manager suggested that it should raise funds through equity as the market was bullish. As per the suggestion of finance manager, the company decided to raise Rs. 3,500 crore from equity for its expansion plan for electric vehicles.
The factor that the finance manager took into consideration to raise funds through equity was :
questions.solution: Option (D) Stock-market conditions is correct. The finance manager recommended raising funds through equity specifically because the market was bullish, meaning share prices were rising and investor sentiment was positive. This makes it an ideal time to issue equity shares at a good price. This is the factor of Stock-Market Conditions. Cash flow position (A) relates to the company's ability to meet debt obligations. Flexibility (B) refers to the ease of restructuring capital. Cost of debt (C) compares interest rates. None of these were mentioned as the reason — the bullish market condition was the deciding factor.
questions.topic: Factors Affecting Choice Between Debt and Equity

questions.text:
'ग्रीन ईट्स' पौधा आधारित भोजन किट की पेशकश करने वाला एक स्टार्ट-अप है । इसने लोकप्रियता प्राप्त की क्योंकि बहुत अधिक युवा उपभोक्ता स्वास्थ्य के प्रति सचेत हो रहे थे तथा दिन प्रतिदिन पर्यावरणीय विषयों के सम्बन्ध में जागरूकता भी बढ़ रही थी । टिकाऊ भोजन के संवर्धन के लिए उन्होंने विद्यालयों एवं महाविद्यालयों के साथ मिलकर उनके लिए कार्यशालाएँ आयोजित कीं ।
उपरोक्त स्थिति में प्रकाशित व्यावसायिक पर्यावरण का घटक पहचानिए :
questions.text_english:
Green-Eats is a start-up offering plant based meal kits. It gained popularity as more young consumers were becoming health conscious and awareness about environmental issues was increasing day-by-day. To promote sustainable eating, they collaborated with schools and colleges and organized workshops for them.
Identify the element of business environment highlighted in the above case :
questions.solution: Option (B) Social Environment is correct. The case highlights changing consumer attitudes — young people becoming health-conscious and increasingly aware of environmental issues. These are social trends and shifts in values, which constitute the Social Environment of business. Green-Eats responded to these social changes by offering plant-based kits. Economic Environment (A) refers to economic conditions like income levels and inflation. Political Environment (C) relates to government policies. Technological Environment (D) involves innovation and technology. The health and environmental consciousness described is purely a social phenomenon.

questions.text:
नेहा, 'न्यूट्रीबाइट' कम्पनी में प्रबंधक के रूप में कार्य कर रही है, जो प्रोटीन युक्त नाश्ता बनाती है और जिसकी माँग बहुत अधिक है । वह संगठन की विपणन योजनाओं को क्रियान्वित करने तथा यह सुनिश्चित करने के लिए उत्तरदायी है कि लक्ष्यों की प्राप्ति के लिए कम्पनी की नीति के अनुसार उसके विभाग में आवश्यक कर्मचारी हैं ।
नेहा प्रबंध के किस 'स्तर' पर कार्य कर रही है, पहचानिए :
questions.text_english:
Neha is working as a Manager at 'NutriBite', a company that makes protein rich snacks which are high in demand. She is responsible for implementing organisation's marketing plans, and ensuring that her department has necessary personnel to achieve goals as per company's policy.
Identify the 'level' of management at which Neha is working :

options.D: दोनों मध्य स्तर तथा प्रचालन स्तर

options_english.D: Both Middle level and Operational level

questions.solution: Option (B) Middle level is correct. Neha is responsible for implementing the organisation's marketing plans and ensuring her department has necessary personnel as per company policy. These are classic functions of Middle Level Management — implementing plans formulated by top management and ensuring that the operational level has adequate human resources. Top level (A) sets overall goals and strategy. Operational level (C) directly supervises workers. Since Neha bridges strategy (top level) and execution (operational level), she is a middle-level manager.

questions.text:
'टेलर का विश्वास था कि औद्योगिक कार्य-कुशलता अधिकांशत: कर्मचारियों की योग्यताओं पर निर्भर करती है । उसका विचार था कि कार्य-कुशलता की नींव कर्मचारी चयन प्रक्रिया के प्रारंभ से ही रखी जा सकती है । प्रत्येक व्यक्ति का चयन वैज्ञानिक रीति से होना चाहिए । सौंपा गया कार्य उनकी योग्यताओं के अनुरूप होना चाहिए । उनकी कार्यक्षमता में वृद्धि के लिए उनको आवश्यक प्रशिक्षण मिलना चाहिए ।'
उपरोक्त में चर्चित वैज्ञानिक प्रबंध का सिद्धान्त है
questions.text_english: 'Taylor believed that industrial efficiency depends to a large extent on personnel competencies. He was of the view that the concern for efficiency could be built in right from the process of employee selection. Each person should be scientifically selected. The work assigned should suit her/his capabilities. To increase efficiency, they should be given the required training.' The principle of scientific management discussed above is :

options.A: विज्ञान पद्धति, न कि अँगूठा टेक नियम
options.D: प्रत्येक व्यक्ति का उसकी अधिकाधिक क्षमता एवं समृद्धि के लिए विकास

options_english.D: Development of Each and Every Person to His or Her Greatest Efficiency and Prosperity.

questions.solution: Option (D) Development of Each and Every Person to His or Her Greatest Efficiency and Prosperity is correct. The passage describes Taylor's belief that efficiency depends on employee competencies, that workers should be scientifically selected based on their abilities, and that they should receive training to improve their capabilities — all of which reflect the principle of developing every individual to their maximum potential. Science not Rule of Thumb (A) focuses on scientific decision-making. Harmony not Discord (B) focuses on management-worker relations. Cooperation not Individualism (C) emphasizes teamwork over individual effort.

questions.text:
'शेयर बाज़ार नए निर्गमों को विनियमित करके, बेहतर व्यापार व्यवहारों तथा जनता को निवेश के बारे में शिक्षित करने हेतु प्रभावी कदम उठाकर विस्तृत शेयर स्वामित्व को सुनिश्चित करने में एक महत्वपूर्ण भूमिका निभा रहा है ।'
उपरोक्त पंक्तियाँ निम्नलिखित में से शेयर बाज़ार के किस कार्य पर प्रकाश डालती हैं ?
questions.text_english:
'Stock Exchange is playing a vital role in ensuring wider share ownership by regulating new issues, better trading practices and taking effective steps in educating the public about investments.'
The above lines highlight which function of stock exchange from the following ?

options.A: सट्टेबाजी के लिए अवसर उपलब्ध कराना

questions.solution: Option (B) Spreading of Equity Cult is correct. The statement describes the Stock Exchange ensuring wider share ownership through regulating new issues, better trading practices, and educating the public about investments. All these activities promote wider participation in equity investment among the general public, which is exactly what 'Spreading of Equity Cult' means. Providing scope for speculation (A) relates to short-term price differences. Safety of Transactions (C) relates to the guarantee mechanism. Contributes to Economic Growth (D) is about channelling savings into investment.

sub_questions.text: समन्वय की किन्हीं तीन विशेषताओं का उल्लेख कीजिए ।
sub_questions.text_english: State any three features of Co-ordination.

key_points: Co-ordination integrates group efforts
Co-ordination ensures unity of action
Co-ordination is a continuous process

sub_questions.solution: Co-ordination is an essential feature of management with several important characteristics. First, it integrates group efforts by unifying and harmonizing the diverse activities of individuals and departments toward common goals. Second, it ensures unity of action, meaning all activities of different departments are aligned so that there is no conflict and the organisation moves in one direction. Third, it is a continuous process — it is not a one-time activity but an ongoing function that managers perform throughout the life of the organisation to maintain harmony.

sub_questions.text: प्रबंध के सिद्धान्तों के महत्त्व के किन्हीं तीन बिंदुओं का उल्लेख कीजिए ।
sub_questions.text_english: State any three points of significance of Principles of Management.

key_points: Providing managers with useful insights into reality
Helping in optimal utilisation of resources
Helping managers in taking scientific decisions

sub_questions.solution: Principles of Management are significant for several reasons. First, they provide managers with useful insights into real-world business situations, helping them understand and interpret management challenges more effectively. Second, they help in the optimal utilisation of resources by enabling managers to plan and organise physical and human resources efficiently, thereby reducing waste. Third, they assist managers in taking scientific and objective decisions based on established guidelines rather than guesswork, thus improving the quality of managerial decision-making.

questions.solution: This question has two alternatives (a) and (b). Answers are provided in sub_questions.
questions.chapter: Nature and Significance of Management / Principles of Management

sub_questions.text: भर्ती के आन्तरिक स्रोतों के रूप में 'स्थानान्तरण' एवं 'पदोन्नति' को समझाइए ।
sub_questions.text_english: Explain 'Transfers' and 'Promotions' as internal sources of recruitment.

key_points: Transfer means moving an employee from one job, department or location to another
Transfer does not involve a change in rank or salary
Promotion means shifting an employee to a higher position with more responsibility and better pay

sub_questions.solution: Transfer is the movement of an employee from one job to another, or from one department, branch, or location to another, at the same level of responsibility and pay. It is used to fill vacancies that arise at similar levels across the organisation and helps in better utilisation of employees' skills. Promotion, on the other hand, involves elevating an employee to a higher position that carries greater responsibilities, a higher status, and usually better pay and benefits. Promotions motivate employees to work harder and act as a reward for good performance, thereby improving morale across the organisation.

sub_questions.text: प्रबन्ध के 'नियुक्तिकरण' कार्य की प्रक्रिया के चरणों के रूप में 'अनुस्थापन तथा अभिविन्यास' एवं 'निष्पादन मूल्यांकन' को समझाइए ।
sub_questions.text_english: Explain 'Placement and Orientation' and 'Performance Appraisal' as steps in the process of 'Staffing' function of management.

key_points: Placement involves assigning the selected candidate to a specific job
Orientation involves introducing the new employee to the organisation, its rules, and colleagues
Performance Appraisal involves evaluating employee performance against set standards

sub_questions.solution: Placement refers to the process of assigning the newly selected candidate to a specific job or position in the organisation. It must match the candidate's qualifications and skills with the job requirements. Orientation, or induction, involves introducing the new employee to the organisation's culture, rules, colleagues, and working environment to help them settle in. Performance Appraisal is the systematic evaluation of an employee's job performance and potential for development. It compares actual performance against predetermined standards and helps in identifying training needs, determining promotions, and deciding compensation adjustments.

questions.solution: This question has two alternatives (a) and (b). Answers are provided in sub_questions.

questions.text: निम्नलिखित प्रत्येक स्थिति में चर्चित भर्ती के बाह्य स्रोत को पहचानिए एवं समझाइए :
questions.text_english: Identify and explain the external source of recruitment discussed in each of the following cases :

sub_questions.text: वीर इन्फ्रास्ट्रक्चर प्राइवेट लिमिटेड, उनेदाबाद में एक सरकारी अस्पताल के भवन निर्माण का कार्य संभाल रही थी । मॉनसून के मौसम में परियोजना में देरी हो गई और समय-सीमा तक पूरा करने के लिए अचानक काम का बोझ बहुत बढ़ गया । स्थल पर्यवेक्षक ने निर्माणी स्थल के प्रवेश पर यह उल्लेख करते हुए एक नोटिस लगाया कि '15 दिन के लिए दिहाड़ी मज़दूरों की आवश्यकता है । पहचान प्रमाण-पत्र के साथ सोमवार को सुबह 9:00 बजे रिपोर्ट करें । चिनाई या सामग्री ढोने के अनुभवी कामगारों को प्राथमिकता दी जाएगी' ।
sub_questions.text_english: Veer Infrastructure Pvt. Ltd. was handling the construction of a government hospital building in Unedabad. During the monsoon season, the project was delayed and there was a sudden rush of work to meet the deadline. The site supervisor placed a notice at the entrance of the construction site stating 'Daily wage labourers needed for 15 days. Report with Identity Proof on Monday at 9:00 A.M. Preference for workers with experience in masonry or carrying materials'.

key_points: External source: Casual or Badli Workers (Gate Hiring)
A notice placed at the gate to attract workers on a temporary daily-wage basis

sub_questions.solution: The external source of recruitment used here is Casual/Badli Workers or Gate Hiring. In this method, workers are recruited on a daily-wage or temporary basis by placing a notice at the entrance of the workplace. People who need casual employment assemble at the gate and are selected based on the immediate requirement. This method is suitable when there is sudden and short-term increase in workload, as seen in this case where Veer Infrastructure needed workers for only 15 days to complete the delayed construction project before the deadline.

sub_questions.text: विस्ता बैंक ने टियर-2 तथा टियर-3 शहरों में अपनी खुदरा बैंकिंग प्रचालनों का विस्तार करने की योजना बनाई । उन्हें 200 से अधिक मध्य-स्तरीय प्रबंधकों को नियुक्त करने की आवश्यकता थी जो विक्रय, उपभोक्ता सेवा तथा प्रचालनों में अनुभवी हों । विस्ता बैंक ने 'एवन कन्सलटेंट्स' से सम्पर्क किया, जो कि भारत की अग्रणी प्रबन्ध परामर्शदाता फर्मों में से एक है । 'एवन कन्सलटेंट्स' ने अपने नाम से जॉब पोर्टल पर पदों का विज्ञापन दिया तथा सम्पूर्ण भारतवर्ष के अनुभवी पेशेवरों का डेटाबेस प्राप्त किया । गहन जाँच के पश्चात् उन्होंने एक संक्षिप्त सूची बनाई तथा विस्ता बैंक को योग्य उम्मीदवारों की सूची प्रेषित कर दी ।
sub_questions.text_english: Vista Bank planned to expand its retail banking operations in Tier-2 and Tier-3 cities. They needed to hire over 200 middle-level managers with experience in sales, customer service and operations. Vista Bank approached 'Avon Consultants', one of India's leading management consultancy firms. 'Avon Consultants' advertised positions on job portals under their own name and also accessed its database of experienced professionals across India. After extensive screening, they shortlisted and forwarded qualified candidates to Vista Bank.

key_points: External source: Management Consultants / Placement Agencies
Specialist firms that maintain databases of candidates and screen them on behalf of client organisations

sub_questions.solution: The external source of recruitment used here is Management Consultants or Placement Agencies. These are specialised firms that help organisations find suitable candidates for various positions, especially at middle and senior levels. They maintain extensive databases of professionals, advertise positions, screen applicants, and forward a shortlist to the client company. In this case, 'Avon Consultants' performed all these activities on behalf of Vista Bank, making it a classic example of using management consultancy firms as an external source of recruitment.

questions.text:

Securities and Exchange Board of India (SEBI) also took immediate notice of the situation and called for detailed trading information and conducted enquiries and inspections. After examining trading information and conducting enquiries, SEBI found that a group of traders had spread false information to artificially boost the stock price. By taking action against the group of traders, SEBI made it clear that fraudulent and unfair trade practices are strictly prohibited.

questions.text_english:
Meera purchased a mixer-grinder of a reputed brand from a well-known electronic store for Rs. 5,000. Within ten days, the mixer-grinder stopped working. Meera visited the shop for repair or replacement showing the cash memo and the warranty card but the shopkeeper refused to help her. Though the product was only for Rs. 5,000, she filed a complaint at the District Consumer Disputes Redressal Forum.
The Forum ordered the store to replace the product within 30 days. They also added Rs. 1,000 as compensation for mental harassment and Rs. 800 for legal costs.
State two responsibilities fulfilled by Meera and two reliefs which Meera got through Consumer Redressal Forum.

key_points: Responsibility 1: Meera was aware of her consumer rights (kept cash memo and warranty card as proof of purchase)
Responsibility 2: Meera filed a complaint and took legal action rather than accepting the shopkeeper's refusal
Relief 1: Replacement of the defective product within 30 days
Relief 2: Compensation of Rs. 1,000 for mental harassment and Rs. 800 for legal costs

questions.solution:
Two responsibilities fulfilled by Meera are: First, she was an aware consumer who preserved documentary proof of her purchase by keeping the cash memo and warranty card — this reflects the responsibility of a consumer to collect proof of transactions. Second, she exercised her legal rights by filing a complaint at the District Consumer Disputes Redressal Forum instead of silently accepting the unfair treatment, reflecting the consumer's responsibility to file complaints against unfair trade practices.

Two reliefs received by Meera from the Consumer Redressal Forum are: First, the Forum ordered the store to replace the defective mixer-grinder within 30 days, providing her with a functional product. Second, Meera received Rs. 1,000 as compensation for mental harassment caused by the shopkeeper's refusal, along with Rs. 800 as reimbursement for the legal costs she incurred in filing the complaint.

sub_questions.text_english: State any four limitations of internal sources of recruitment.

key_points: Restricts fresh talent from entering the organisation
Employees may become complacent knowing they will be promoted by seniority
Creates conflict among employees who are not selected for promotion
Limits the choice of candidates; management cannot select the best talent from outside

sub_questions.solution: Internal sources of recruitment have several limitations. First, they restrict the inflow of fresh talent and new ideas into the organisation, which can stagnate innovation and creativity. Second, employees may become complacent, knowing that promotions are largely based on seniority, reducing motivation to perform better. Third, it can create resentment and conflict among employees who are not selected for promotion, which harms team morale. Fourth, the organisation is limited in its choice of candidates and may not always find the most suitable person for a position from within, whereas the external talent pool could offer better qualified individuals.

sub_questions.text_english: State any four benefits of staffing to the organization.

key_points: Helps in finding and placing the right person in the right job
Ensures continuous survival and growth of the organisation through human resource planning
Optimum utilisation of human resources
Improves job satisfaction and morale of employees through fair evaluation and rewards

sub_questions.solution: Staffing provides several important benefits to an organisation. First, it ensures that the right person is placed in the right job, which increases productivity and reduces wastage of human talent. Second, through human resource planning, staffing ensures continuous availability of competent employees for current and future needs, supporting the organisation's long-term growth. Third, it leads to optimum utilisation of human resources by matching job requirements with employee capabilities, thereby reducing overstaffing or understaffing. Fourth, fair performance appraisal and reward systems improve employee morale, job satisfaction, and commitment to the organisation, which reduces employee turnover.

Aditya owned a skincare company named 'Nat-Ayur'. In July, 2025, he decided to launch a new herbal face cream in the market using traditional herbs like turmeric, sandalwood, neem, aloe vera, saffron etc.
The total cost of producing, packaging, distributing and selling the cream came to Rs. 60 per tube. 'Nat-Ayur' decided that this would be the minimum price to cover the cost. They wanted to earn a fair margin of profit too. For this 'Nat-Ayur' conducted a survey and found that the expected demand would be high. Customers were ready to pay more for herbal and chemical free products. They also found that many face creams with similar features are available in the market priced between Rs. 80 to Rs. 120. To compete effectively, 'Nat-Ayur' decided to price the cream at Rs. 99 to attract the customers while offering better benefits.
To add value to the product 'Nat-Ayur' invested in eco-friendly packaging, free home delivery and on-line advertisements. This uniqueness gives 'Nat-Ayur' a competitive freedom in fixing price of its cream.
Identify and explain any two factors that were taken into consideration by 'Nat-Ayur' for determining the price of their herbal face cream.

key_points: Factor 1: Cost of Product — The total cost of production was Rs. 60, which was set as the minimum price
Factor 2: Competition — Similar products were priced between Rs. 80 to Rs. 120, influencing Nat-Ayur to price at Rs. 99
Factor 3 (alternate): Demand — Survey showed high demand and customers' willingness to pay more for herbal products

questions.solution:
Two factors considered by 'Nat-Ayur' for pricing their herbal face cream are:

First, Cost of the Product. The total cost of producing, packaging, distributing and selling the cream was Rs. 60 per tube. This was identified as the minimum price below which selling would result in a loss. All pricing decisions begin with cost recovery, and Nat-Ayur used this as the floor price while also factoring in a fair profit margin. This is the most fundamental factor in pricing decisions.

Second, Competition. Nat-Ayur's market survey revealed that similar herbal face creams were available in the market priced between Rs. 80 and Rs. 120. To compete effectively against these products, Nat-Ayur priced their cream at Rs. 99 — lower than the upper end of competitors' prices but still positioned to attract value-conscious customers. The pricing reflects a deliberate competitive strategy to gain market share while remaining profitable.

sub_questions.text_english:
Explain the following limitations of planning :
(i) Planning leads to rigidity
(ii) Planning may not work in a dynamic environment

key_points: Rigidity: Once a plan is made, managers may be reluctant to change it even when circumstances change
Dynamic environment: Business environment is constantly changing; plans made today may become obsolete

sub_questions.solution:
Planning leads to rigidity because once a course of action is decided and formalised into a plan, managers and employees may be reluctant or unable to deviate from it, even when circumstances change. This inflexibility can prevent the organisation from taking advantage of new opportunities or responding quickly to unexpected problems. The plan becomes a constraint rather than a guide, limiting the freedom of employees to act spontaneously in the organisation's best interest.

Planning may not work in a dynamic environment because the business environment is constantly changing due to factors like technological advancements, changing consumer preferences, new government policies, and economic fluctuations. Plans are made based on forecasts of future conditions, but if those conditions change significantly and rapidly, even the most carefully made plan may become irrelevant or counterproductive. Since planning involves committing resources based on predicted futures, frequent changes in the environment render such commitments wasteful.

Explain the following points of importance of Decentralisation :
(i) Develops initiative among subordinates
(ii) Develops managerial talent for the future.

key_points: Initiative: When subordinates are given authority, they develop confidence and learn to take independent decisions
Managerial talent: By giving junior managers decision-making power, they gain experience for future senior roles

sub_questions.solution:
Decentralisation develops initiative among subordinates by giving them the authority and freedom to make decisions within their area of work. When subordinates are empowered to take independent decisions rather than always seeking approval from superiors, they develop confidence, creative thinking, and a sense of responsibility. Over time, this cultivates a proactive mindset and the habit of showing initiative in problem-solving, which benefits both the individual and the organisation.

Decentralisation develops managerial talent for the future by providing lower-level managers with practical experience in decision-making. As they handle real authority and face the consequences of their decisions, they gain skills, knowledge, and judgement that are essential for senior managerial roles. This creates a pool of experienced and capable managers who are ready to take on greater responsibilities in the future, ensuring the long-term leadership continuity of the organisation.

'प्रिया मोटर्स' ने, जो एक मोटर-बाइक का उत्पादन करने वाली कम्पनी है, 'मोटो ग्लाइड III' नाम से बाइक का एक नया मॉडल बाज़ार में उतारा है । कम्पनी ने इस बाइक को युवा सवारों के लिए आकर्षक बनाने के लिए सावधानीपूर्वक योजना बनाई । डिज़ाइन टीम का ध्यान लक्षित उपभोक्ताओं, प्राथमिक रूप से युवाओं, के लिए बाइक को आकर्षक तथा स्टाइलिश बनाने की ओर केन्द्रित था । उन्होंने इसे स्थूल स्वरूप, तेज हेडलाइट्स और एक डिजिटल स्पीडोमीटर दिया । डिज़ाइन ने बाइक को न केवल देखने में अच्छा बनाया अपितु इसकी वायुगतिकी और ईंधन दक्षता में भी सुधार किया । इसने कम्पनी को अन्य ब्रान्ड से अलग खड़े होने में सहायता की और इस प्रकार प्रतिस्पर्धात्मक बढ़त हासिल की ।
कम्पनी ने बाइक के प्रत्येक भाग को बनाने में सख्त गुणवत्ता मानकों का पालन किया जिससे उत्पादन में एकरूपता और स्थिरता प्राप्त करने में मद्द मिली । 'प्रिया मोटर्स' ने बाइक के विभिन्न संस्करण पेश किए जिनके मूल्य विशेषताओं जैसे ब्लूटूथ सम्बद्धता, रंग विकल्प इत्यादि के आधार पर अलग-अलग थे ।
उपरोक्त में चर्चित विपणन के दो कार्यों को पहचानिए एवं समझाइए ।

'Priya Motors', a motorbike manufacturing company, launched a new model of bike in the market named 'Moto Glide III'. The company planned carefully to make this bike appeal to young riders. The design team focused on making the bike attractive and stylish to the target customers, primarily the youth. They gave it a sleek body, sharp headlights and a digital speedometer. The design made the bike not just look good but also improved its aerodynamics and fuel efficiency. This helped the company stand out from other brands, thereby getting a competitive edge.
The company followed strict quality standards in making each part of the bike which helped in achieving uniformity and consistency in output. 'Priya Motors' also offered different versions of bike with different prices based on features like Bluetooth connectivity, colour options etc.
Identify and explain two functions of marketing discussed above.

key_points: Function 1: Product designing and development — designing the bike to be stylish, aerodynamic, and fuel-efficient
Function 2: Standardisation and Grading — following strict quality standards for uniformity and consistency in production

questions.solution:
Two functions of marketing discussed in the case are:

First, Product Designing and Development. The design team of Priya Motors focused on making the 'Moto Glide III' attractive and stylish for young customers by giving it a sleek body, sharp headlights, and a digital speedometer. The design also improved aerodynamics and fuel efficiency, giving the company a competitive edge. Product designing involves creating the physical form and features of a product that match consumer needs and preferences. A well-designed product helps differentiate the brand in a competitive market.

Second, Standardisation and Grading. Priya Motors followed strict quality standards in making each part of the bike, achieving uniformity and consistency in production. Standardisation involves setting product specifications and ensuring that all products conform to these set standards. This builds consumer trust and ensures quality. Additionally, Priya Motors offered different versions of the bike at different prices based on features like Bluetooth and colour options, which reflects grading — classifying products into different grades or categories based on their features.

sub_questions.text_english: Explain 'Science, not Rule of Thumb' as a principle of Scientific Management and 'Functional Foremanship' and 'Time study' as techniques of Scientific Management.

key_points: Science not Rule of Thumb: Scientific investigation should replace guesswork in decision-making
Functional Foremanship: Division of factory into 8 specialised foremen replacing the single foreman
Time Study: Determining the standard time to complete each task

sub_questions.solution:
Science, not Rule of Thumb means that managers should use scientific methods based on observation, experimentation, and analysis when making decisions, rather than relying on intuition, tradition, or personal judgment (the 'rule of thumb'). Taylor believed that for every element of work there should be a scientifically determined best method. This eliminates hit-and-trial approaches and ensures higher efficiency and consistency in work performance.

Functional Foremanship is a technique in which Taylor replaced the traditional single foreman with eight specialised supervisors, each responsible for a specific function. Four planning supervisors — route clerk, instruction card clerk, time and cost clerk, and disciplinarian — handle the planning side. Four execution supervisors — gang boss, speed boss, repair boss, and inspector — handle the shop floor. Each worker receives instructions from eight different specialists, ensuring expert guidance in every aspect of work. This improves quality, speed, and efficiency.

Time Study involves determining the standard time required by an average worker to complete a specific task under normal working conditions. Taylor used a stopwatch to measure and record the time taken for each element of a job. This helps management set fair output targets, determine the number of workers needed, design incentive schemes, and estimate labour costs accurately. It ensures that workers are neither overloaded nor underutilised.

sub_questions.text_english:
Explain the following principles of General Management :
(i) Unity of Command
(ii) Esprit De Corps
(iii) Stability of Personnel

key_points: Unity of Command: Each employee should receive orders from only one superior
Esprit De Corps: Team spirit and harmony among employees should be promoted
Stability of Personnel: Employees should not be transferred too frequently; stability improves efficiency

sub_questions.solution:
Unity of Command, as propounded by Henri Fayol, states that an employee should receive orders and instructions from one superior only. When an employee is accountable to multiple superiors, it creates confusion, divided loyalty, and conflict in following instructions. A single line of command ensures clarity of authority and accountability, and prevents overlapping of authority and responsibility.

Esprit De Corps, which means 'team spirit', emphasises that management should promote a spirit of unity, cooperation, and harmony among employees. Fayol believed that the strength of an organisation lies in the unity of its people. Managers should avoid dividing employees into groups and instead foster mutual respect and teamwork. A united team performs far better than a fragmented one and contributes to organisational success.

Stability of Personnel means that employees should not be transferred or replaced too frequently. High turnover and frequent changes in personnel lead to inefficiency and increased costs of recruitment and training. Fayol advocated that employees should be given time to settle into their roles, develop expertise, and contribute meaningfully. A stable workforce builds institutional knowledge and improves overall organisational performance.

'फ्रेशजू' एक व्यापारी कम्पनी है, जो अन्य निर्माताओं द्वारा बनाए गए बोतलबंद जूस बेचती है । अब इसने अपने जूस को सम्पूर्ण भारत में बेचने की योजना बनाई है । इसके लिए, 'फ्रेशजू' ने जूस के उत्पादन में प्रवेश करने का निर्णय लिया । उसने भविष्य में अन्य देशों को अपने जूस का निर्यात करने की भी एक महत्वाकांक्षी योजना बनाई है । भविष्य में अपेक्षित ऊँची माँग को पूरा करने के लिए, कम्पनी ने एक बड़ी निर्माणी इकाई की स्थापना की । मुख्य कार्यकारी अधिकारी, रविन्द्र, ने जूस भरने और बोतल भरने की स्वचालित मशीन का ऑर्डर दिया जिसे गति बढ़ाने, स्वच्छता में सुधार करने और उत्पादन में निरंतरता लाने के लिए प्रयोग किया जाता है । चूँकि निवेश बहुत बड़ा था, 'फ्रेशजू' ने सभी नई मशीनों को खरीदने के स्थान पर कुछ महँगी मशीनों को पट्टे पर लिया । इससे उन्हें आरंभ में धन की बचत में सहायता मिली ।
उन्होंने पास की एक पैकेजिंग इकाई के साथ सहयोग भी किया ताकि व्यस्ततम अवधि के दौरान उनकी पैकेजिंग मशीनों का उपयोग किया जा सके । इससे अतिरिक्त उपकरणों में निवेश किए बिना, जो मंदी के दौरान कम उपयोग में रहते हैं, फ्रेशजू को माँग के मौसमी उछाल के प्रबंधन में सहायता मिली ।
उपरोक्त से पंक्तियाँ उद्धृत करते हुए ऐसे किन्हीं चार तत्त्वों को पहचानिए एवं समझाइए जो 'फ्रेशजू' की स्थायी पूँजी आवश्यकताओं को प्रभावित करेंगे ।
questions.text_english:
'Freshju' is a trading company, selling bottled juices made by other manufacturers. Now, it planned to sell its juices across India. For this, 'Freshju' decided to enter into 'Juice manufacturing'. It also has ambitious plans to export its juices to other countries in the future. To meet anticipated higher demand in future, the company set-up a larger manufacturing unit. The Chief Executive Officer, Ravinder, ordered automatic juice-filling and bottling machines to increase speed, improve hygiene and for consistency in production. Since the investment was huge, instead of buying all new machinery 'Freshju' took some expensive machines on lease.
They also collaborated with a nearby packaging unit to use their packing machines during peak-season. This helped 'Freshju' to manage seasonal surges in demand without investing in additional equipment that would remain underutilized during off season.
Quoting lines from the above, identify and explain any four factors that will affect the fixed capital requirements of 'Freshju'.

key_points: Nature of Business: Moving from trading to manufacturing increases fixed capital needs
Scale of Operations: Setting up a larger manufacturing unit increases fixed capital
Technology/Level of Automation: Ordering automatic machines increases fixed capital requirements
Leasing vs Buying: Taking machines on lease reduces immediate fixed capital requirements
Collaboration: Sharing packaging machines avoids investment in additional fixed assets

questions.solution:
Four factors affecting the fixed capital requirements of 'Freshju' are:

First, Nature of Business. Quoted line: 'Freshju decided to enter into Juice manufacturing.' Freshju is transitioning from trading (which requires minimal fixed assets) to manufacturing. Manufacturing firms need heavy investment in plant, machinery, and equipment. This shift dramatically increases fixed capital requirements compared to a trading operation.

Second, Scale of Operations. Quoted line: 'The company set-up a larger manufacturing unit.' A larger scale of operations requires more land, buildings, and machinery. As the scale of production increases, the investment in fixed assets like factory buildings and production equipment also increases proportionately, raising fixed capital requirements.

Third, Level of Technology. Quoted line: 'Ravinder ordered automatic juice-filling and bottling machines to increase speed, improve hygiene and for consistency in production.' When a company adopts capital-intensive and automated technology, the cost of machinery is significantly higher. Automatic machines are more expensive than manual ones, leading to higher fixed capital investment.

Fourth, Leasing versus Buying. Quoted line: 'Instead of buying all new machinery, Freshju took some expensive machines on lease.' A company that leases equipment instead of purchasing it outright reduces its fixed capital requirements significantly. Leasing allows use of assets without major upfront investment, freeing up capital for other purposes.

ग्रीनर ऑर्गैनिक एक कम्पनी है जो पर्यावरण हितैषी उर्वरक व मृदा सुधार उत्पादों का उत्पादन करती है । जैविक खेती में बढ़ती हुई रुचि के साथ, कम्पनी सम्पूर्ण भारत में अपने प्रचालनों का विस्तार करने की योजना बना रही है ।
ग्रीनर ने अगले वर्ष अपने विक्रय को 25% से बढ़ाने का लक्ष्य निर्धारित किया । इसने सभी विभागों – विक्रय, उत्पादन, विपणन तथा लॉजिस्टिक्स को काम करने के लिए एक समान लक्ष्य दिया । इसकी प्राप्ति के लिए ग्रीनर ने स्थानीय किसान समूहों के साथ मिलकर टियर-2 तथा टियर-3 शहरों में प्रवेश की एक व्यापक योजना बनाई । उन्होंने ऑनलाइन अभियानों के माध्यम से, जो पर्यावरण हितैषी खेती पर केन्द्रित थे, अपने ब्रान्ड के संवर्धन की योजना भी बनाई । कम्पनी ने विस्तृत मानदण्ड (पैरामीटर्स) भी बनाए जिनके अंतर्गत प्रबंधक कार्य कर सकते थे । प्रयोग में लाया गया समस्त कच्चा माल जैविक प्रमाणित होता था तथा प्राथमिक रूप से स्थानीय किसानों से एकत्रित किया जाता था । इससे गुणवत्ता में सुधार होगा, स्थानीय लोगों को सहायता मिलेगी और उपभोक्ताओं के साथ विश्वास बना रहेगा । कम्पनी ने विपणन के लिए ` 50 लाख आबंटित किए जिसमें स्थानीय समाचार-पत्रों में विज्ञापन, डिजिटल विपणन, प्रचार कार्यक्रम तथा डीलर प्रोत्साहन के लिए कोष सम्मिलित था । भावी तथ्यों तथा संख्याओं की मात्रा के निर्धारण द्वारा, कम्पनी ने लागत को नियंत्रित करने तथा निष्पादन का मूल्यांकन करने की योजना बनाई ।
उपरोक्त स्थिति में चर्चित किन्हीं चार प्रकार की योजनाओं को पहचानिए एवं समझाइए ।
questions.text_english:
Greener Organic is a company producing eco-friendly fertilizers and soil boosters. With the growing interest in organic farming, the company is planning to expand its operations across India.
Greener sets its target to increase its sales by 25% in the next year. This gave all departments – sales, production, marketing and logistics – a common target to work. To achieve this, Greener made a comprehensive plan to enter Tier-2 and Tier-3 cities by working with local farmer groups. They also plan to promote their brand through on-line campaigns focused on eco-friendly farming. The company also laid down broad parameters within which the managers could function. All raw materials used had to be certified organic and preferably sourced from local farmers. This would improve quality, support local people and build trust with customers. The company allocated Rs. 50 lakhs for marketing, which included funds for regional newspaper advertisements, digital marketing, promotional events and dealer incentives. By quantifying future facts and figures, the company planned to control costs and evaluate performance.
Identify and explain any four type of plans discussed in the above case.

key_points: Objective: Increase sales by 25% in the next year
Strategy: Comprehensive plan to enter Tier-2 and Tier-3 cities by working with local farmer groups and promote brand through online campaigns
Policy: All raw materials used had to be certified organic and preferably sourced from local farmers
Budget: Company allocated Rs. 50 lakhs for marketing

questions.solution:
Four types of plans identified in the case of Greener Organic are:

First, Objective. 'Greener sets its target to increase its sales by 25% in the next year. This gave all departments — sales, production, marketing and logistics — a common target to work.' Objectives are the desired end results or goals that an organisation aims to achieve within a given time period. They provide a common direction to all departments and serve as the foundation for all other plans.

Second, Strategy. 'Greener made a comprehensive plan to enter Tier-2 and Tier-3 cities by working with local farmer groups. They also plan to promote their brand through on-line campaigns focused on eco-friendly farming.' A strategy is a comprehensive and integrated plan that defines the long-term direction of the organisation and determines how it will deploy its resources to achieve its objectives. Entering new markets through specific channels is a strategic plan.

Third, Policy. 'All raw materials used had to be certified organic and preferably sourced from local farmers.' A policy is a general guideline or set of parameters that channels the thinking and actions of managers and employees when making decisions. Greener's policy on organic-only raw material sourcing guides procurement decisions consistently across the organisation.

Fourth, Budget. 'The company allocated Rs. 50 lakhs for marketing, which included funds for regional newspaper advertisements, digital marketing, promotional events and dealer incentives. By quantifying future facts and figures, the company planned to control costs and evaluate performance.' A budget is a statement of expected results expressed in numerical terms for a specific time period. It translates plans into financial terms and serves as a tool for controlling costs and measuring performance.

sub_questions.text_english: Explain any four semantic barriers to communication.

key_points: Badly expressed message: Poor choice of words, incorrect grammar, or ambiguous language
Symbols with different meanings: Same word or symbol interpreted differently by sender and receiver
Faulty translation: Message loses meaning when translated from one language to another
Unclarified assumptions: Unstated assumptions made by the sender that the receiver may not share

sub_questions.solution:
Semantic barriers to communication arise from problems with the words or symbols used in a message. Four such barriers are:

First, Badly expressed message. This occurs when the sender uses vague, ambiguous, or poorly constructed language. Wrong choice of words, missing information, or confused sentence structure can make the message difficult to understand. The receiver may misinterpret the intended meaning, leading to breakdowns in communication.

Second, Symbols with different meanings. Many words and symbols carry multiple meanings depending on the context or the background of the receiver. For example, the word 'plant' can mean a factory or a tree. If the sender and receiver attach different meanings to the same word, the message is misunderstood. Technical jargon used without explanation can also create this problem.

Third, Faulty translation. When a message is translated from one language to another, the translator may not always find exact equivalents for certain words or idioms. As a result, the translated version may alter or lose the original meaning of the message. This is especially problematic in multinational organisations where communication crosses language barriers.

Fourth, Unclarified assumptions. Sometimes the sender assumes that the receiver has the same background knowledge or understanding of certain facts. When these assumptions are not stated explicitly, the receiver may interpret the message in a completely different way than intended. This gap between what is assumed and what is understood creates a semantic barrier.

sub_questions.text: प्रबन्ध के निर्देशन कार्य के महत्त्व के किन्हीं चार बिन्दुओं को समझाइए ।
sub_questions.text_english: Explain any four points of importance of directing function of management.

key_points: Initiates action: Plans are converted into performance through directing
Integrates employees' efforts: Directing harmonises individual goals with organisational goals
Means of motivation: Directing motivates employees to give their best performance
Facilitates change: Directing helps the organisation adapt to new situations

sub_questions.solution:
The directing function of management is important for the following reasons:

First, it initiates action. Directing is the function through which the actual work begins. Plans, organisational structures, and staffed positions remain inactive until managers direct employees by issuing instructions and guiding their work. Without directing, plans would remain on paper and resources would remain unutilised.

Second, it integrates employees' efforts. Directing integrates the individual efforts of all employees and departments toward the common goals of the organisation. By guiding and motivating employees, managers ensure that every person's work contributes to the overall mission. It bridges the gap between personal aspirations and organisational objectives.

Third, it provides means of motivation. Through effective directing — which includes leadership, communication, and motivation — managers inspire employees to perform at their highest potential. Motivated employees work with enthusiasm, take initiative, and contribute positively to productivity and organisational success.

Fourth, it facilitates change. Business environments change constantly, and organisations must adapt. Directing helps management introduce new ideas, methods, and systems to employees and overcome resistance to change. By communicating the need for change and guiding employees through transitions, directing ensures that the organisation remains adaptable and competitive.
